verdict.rationale: Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back agent definitions is a fair axis for an agent-building SDK, but the evidence pack has nothing on it. Tracing and the Traces dashboard [docs-9, docs-16] cover reviewing individual runs, not versions of an automation. Resuming from a RunState [docs-12] continues a paused run; it is not a rollback to an earlier version. Agents being defined in code suggests external version control could work, but no evidence documents this.
